blocks.title: Discussion
blocks.content:
We have reformulated the bosonic sector of Weinberg-Salam theory in terms of 
quaternions. It predicts mH=j2mw and sin2 Bw=1/4 at the classical level. The 
renormalization effects are not considered in this paper. The present experimentsl3) 
indicate that mHo>48 GeV, mw=80 GeV and sin
2Bw=0.23, 10 % down from 0.25. If 
the relation mH=j2mw is correct within ±10 % corrections, the Higgs mass would be 
in the range 100 ~ 125 Ge V. If it is not correct and Higgs will not be found in that 
mass range nor at all, the basic algebraic idea of Coquereaux et al. using Eq. (15)
